title: Xuefu Zhuyu decoction attenuates thoracic aortic dissection by regulating VSMC phenotypic switching and oxidative stress via the JAK2/STAT3/HIF-1alpha pathway.
authors: Cheng-Wen, Li; Rong, Gao; Yi-Fan, Jiang; Shou-Jia, Wang; Si-Yi, Li; Chun-Yan, Li; Fan, Liang; Xiao-Qiang, Li; Wei-Xun, Duan; Fan, Song
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨中药血府逐瘀汤通过JAK2/STAT3/HIF-1alpha通路调节血管平滑肌细胞表型转换和氧化应激治疗胸主动脉夹层，核心是疾病机制与药物作用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Xuefu Zhuyu Decoction (XFZY), a classic formula for "blood stasis syndrome", has insufficient evidence for its thoracic aortic dissection (TAD) therapeutic efficacy and its underlying mechanism remains unclear. AIM OF STUDY: This study aimed to elucidate the efficacy, mechanism, and key components of XFZY against TAD. MATERIAL AND METHOD: Using a beta-Aminopropionitrile (BAPN)-induced TAD mouse model, efficacy was assessed via survival, ultrasonography, and histology. Mechanisms were explored via integrated UPLC-Q-TOF-MS, clinical proteomics, bioinformatics, and molecular docking, with validation by western blotting and immunofluorescence. RESULTS: In TAD mice, XFZY exerted significant therapeutic effects, as evidenced by reduced mortality (mortality: 40.0% in TAD vs. 13.3% in high-dose group), attenuated aortic dilation (maximum diameter: 1.49 +/- 0.08 mm in TAD vs. 1.10 +/- 0.04 mm in high-dose group), ameliorated histopathological changes, restored VSMC contractile phenotype, and mitigated oxidative stress. Proteomic analyses identified 339 dysregulated proteins, and pinpointed JAK2/STAT3/HIF-1alpha axis as core regulatory axis. XFZY dose-dependently inhibited JAK2/STAT3 activation and HIF-1alpha expression. Molecular docking identified Naringin, Kaempferol, Glycyrrhizic acid, and Saikosaponins A/D as key components, with anti-TAD efficacy confirmed in vivo. CONCLUSION: XFZY attenuated aortic tissue remodeling and improved the survival rate in TAD mice. This therapeutic effect was achieved by rescuing the VSMC contractile phenotype (inhibition of the JAK2/STAT3 pathway) and alleviating oxidative stress (downregulation of HIF-1alpha expression). Naringin, Kaempferol, Glycyrrhizic acid, and Saikosaponins A/D were identified as key components and exhibit effects similar to those of the XFZY extract. These findings establish a solid experimental basis for its clinical application.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：血府逐瘀汤（XFZY）作为“血瘀证”的经典方剂，其在胸主动脉夹层（TAD）治疗疗效方面的证据尚不充分，且其潜在机制仍不明确。研究目的：本研究旨在阐明XFZY对TAD的疗效、机制及关键成分。材料与方法：采用β-氨基丙腈（BAPN）诱导的TAD小鼠模型，通过生存率、超声检查和组织学评估疗效。通过整合UPLC-Q-TOF-MS、临床蛋白质组学、生物信息学和分子对接探索机制，并通过western blotting和免疫荧光进行验证。结果：在TAD小鼠中，XFZY表现出显著的治疗效果，表现为死亡率降低（TAD组死亡率：40.0% vs. 高剂量组13.3%）、主动脉扩张减轻（最大直径：TAD组1.49 ± 0.08 mm vs. 高剂量组1.10 ± 0.04 mm）、组织病理学改变改善、血管平滑肌细胞（VSMC）收缩表型恢复以及氧化应激缓解。蛋白质组学分析鉴定出339个失调蛋白，并确定JAK2/STAT3/HIF-1α轴为核心调控轴。XFZY剂量依赖性地抑制JAK2/STAT3激活和HIF-1α表达。分子对接鉴定出柚皮苷、山柰酚、甘草酸和柴胡皂苷A/D为关键成分，其抗TAD疗效在体内得到验证。结论：XFZY减轻了TAD小鼠的主动脉组织重塑并提高了生存率。这一治疗效应通过恢复VSMC收缩表型（抑制JAK2/STAT3通路）和缓解氧化应激（下调HIF-1α表达）实现。柚皮苷、山柰酚、甘草酸和柴胡皂苷A/D被鉴定为关键成分，并表现出与XFZY提取物相似的作用。这些发现为其临床应用奠定了坚实的实验基础。
